headline: Vendor-scale reports arrive — Xiaomi-Robotics-1 and FoMoVLA push MoT + foresight designs

insights.title: Industry labs ship scaling reports alongside academia
insights.body: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 (2.6–10.5B Mixture-of-Transformers, Qwen3-VL VLM + flow-matching DiT) posts RoboCasa 74.5 / RoboCasa365 57.4 with a full deployment stack, while FoMoVLA (LiAuto/UCAS/Tsinghua) enters the LIBERO top-13 at #10 (98.75) by attaching a foresight world-model and point-tracking as TRAINING-ONLY auxiliary branches — removed at inference so the flow-matching DiT ships lean. Vendor-scale tech reports are now a regular fixture of the twice-weekly scan.

insights.title: Robustness & recovery become explicit design targets
insights.body: Four of nine accepted models center on reliability rather than raw success: AC-VLA (CoRL, OOD action correction), Agentic-RL-Execution (a PPO meta-policy choosing EXECUTE/RETRY/REPAIR/RESET over a frozen VLA), DiMaS (optimal-transport inference-time steering), and LIFT (force-aware post-training). Together with last week's TrustVLA/SEAM, the inference-time-wrapper category keeps compounding — reliability layered onto policies you don't retrain.

insights.title: 348 models; two more framework/analysis papers filtered
insights.body: The tracker reached 348 PDF-verified models. Curation stayed strict: PhyAgentOS (an embodied-agent OS that treats VLAs as swappable backends) and a reasoning-robustness analysis paper were both rejected as non-policy, and re-entering prior rejects (Jetson-PI runtime, ActiveFly-Bench) were skipped — keeping the count to genuine policy contributions.
